info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Bill Payment Transaction Generation API
info.description: The Bill Payment Transaction Generation API facilitates seamless processing of bill payment transactions within the financial ecosystem. This endpoint allows users to initiate new transactions, ensuring that funds are transferred efficiently to payees. Typical consumers include financial institutions, payment processors, and third-party applications that require automation of bill payments. By integrating this API, businesses can enhance their payment offerings, improve cash flow management, and deliver a better experience to their customers.

post.summary: Initiates a bill payment switch transfer.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to initiate a transfer for switching bill payment methods. It streamlines the process of transferring funds to pay bills through selected payment methods, ensuring seamless and efficient transactions.
